args.title: Tamarack Components: Warehouse automation in 2026 (article + companion)
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts in 2026 warehouse automation deployments.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Source: Tamarack Components newsletter "Warehouse automation in 2026" (blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse) and its companion piece (insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion).
